-- Contador visual no canto superior direito

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

end

gui.Name = "FPSCounter"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name = "FPSLabel"
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 38)
label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -155, 0, 12)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
label.BorderSizePixel = 0
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
label.TextSize = 18
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.Text = "FPS: calculando..."
label.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = label

local frames = 0
local elapsed = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    frames = frames + 1
    elapsed = elapsed + dt

    if elapsed >= 0.5 then
        local fps = math.floor(frames / elapsed + 0.5)

        label.Text = "FPS: " .. fps

        if fps >= 50 then
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        elseif fps >= 30 then
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
        else
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
        end

        frames = 0
        elapsed = 0
    end
end)

print("FPS Counter ativado!")

-- ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- snowtail spam.lua  v3.1 — safe bandwidth edition
-- SetPlayerBlockList flooder (standalone)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- ─── theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
local Theme = {
    Bg = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250), BgTrans = 0.20,
    Element = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), ElementTrans = 0.55,
    Border = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 220), BorderTrans = 0.5,
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(90, 130, 240),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40), TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 86), RedHover = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 122),
    Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 189, 46), YellowHover = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 100),
    Green = Color3.fromRGB(39, 201, 63), GreenHover = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 100),
}
local FONT = Enum.Font.Gotham
local FONTB = Enum.Font.GothamBold
local CORNER_MAIN = 20
local CORNER_ELEMENT = 10

local Instances, Connections = {}, {}
local function track(i) table.insert(Instances, i); return i end
local function conn(c) table.insert(Connections, c); return c end
local function newCorner(p, r) local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or CORNER_ELEMENT); c.Parent = p; return c end
local function newStroke(p, t)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Theme.Border; s.Thickness = t or 1
    s.Transparency = Theme.BorderTrans
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    s.Parent = p; return s
end
local function smooth(i, p, d)
    return TweenService:Create(i, TweenInfo.new(d or 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), p)
end

-- ─── spam state ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local Spam = {
    Enabled = false, Running = false, Building = false,
    FireBurst = 1, FrameDelay = 0.1,
    Children = 20000, NestedPerChild = 0, FieldsPerChild = 1, FieldSize = 0,
    RebuildEach = false, FireCount = 0,
    Remote = nil, Cache = nil, Thread = nil, Pad = "",
    SessionStart = nil, NullSince = nil, LastResult = nil,
}

pcall(function() game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge) end)

local function resolveRemote()
    local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
    if not rrs then return nil end
    local r = rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
    if r and (r:IsA("RemoteEvent") or r:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then return r end
    return nil
end
Spam.Remote = resolveRemote()

local function rebuildPad()
    Spam.Pad = Spam.FieldSize > 0 and string.rep("P", Spam.FieldSize) or ""
end
rebuildPad()

local function buildPayload()
    local n = Spam.Children
    local fields = Spam.FieldsPerChild
    local nested = Spam.NestedPerChild
    local pad = Spam.Pad or ""
    local usePad = Spam.FieldSize > 0
    local root = table.create(n)
    for i = 1, n do
        local entry = { id = i, v = i * 2 }
        for k = 1, fields do
            entry["k" .. k] = usePad and pad or (i + k)
        end
        for j = 1, nested do
            entry["n" .. j] = { a = i, b = j }
        end
        root[i] = entry
    end
    return root
end

local function fireN(remote, payload, n)
    for i = 1, n do
        remote:FireServer(payload)
    end
end

local worker
worker = function()
    while Spam.Running do
        if not Spam.Remote then Spam.Remote = resolveRemote() end
        local cache = Spam.Cache
        local remote = Spam.Remote
        if remote and cache then
            local n = Spam.FireBurst
            local ok = pcall(fireN, remote, cache, n)
            if ok then
                Spam.FireCount = Spam.FireCount + n
            else
                Spam.Remote = nil
            end
        end
        if Spam.FrameDelay > 0 then task.wait(Spam.FrameDelay) else RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
    end
end

local function ensureCacheThenStart()
    if Spam.Building then return end
    if Spam.Cache then
        Spam.Enabled = true
        if not Spam.Running then
            Spam.Running = true
            Spam.SessionStart = tick()
            Spam.LastResult = nil
            Spam.Thread = task.spawn(worker)
        end
        return
    end
    Spam.Building = true
    Spam.Enabled = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local snapC, snapN, snapF, snapS = Spam.Children, Spam.NestedPerChild, Spam.FieldsPerChild, Spam.FieldSize
        rebuildPad()
        local ok, payload = pcall(buildPayload)
        Spam.Building = false
        if not ok or not payload then Spam.Enabled = false; return end
        if not Spam.Enabled then return end
        if Spam.Children ~= snapC or Spam.NestedPerChild ~= snapN or Spam.FieldsPerChild ~= snapF or Spam.FieldSize ~= snapS then
            ensureCacheThenStart(); return
        end
        Spam.Cache = payload
        if not Spam.Running then
            Spam.Running = true
            Spam.SessionStart = tick()
            Spam.LastResult = nil
            Spam.Thread = task.spawn(worker)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopSpam()
    Spam.Enabled = false
    Spam.Running = false
    Spam.Thread = nil
end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not espDrawings[player] then
                createESP(player)
            end
            
            local drawings = espDrawings[player]
            local char = player.Character
            local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

local function findPlayer(query)
    if not query or query == "" then return nil end
    query = string.lower(query)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.lower(player.Name) == query or string.lower(player.DisplayName) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.sub(nameLower, 1, #query) == query or string.sub(displayLower, 1, #query) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.find(nameLower, query, 1, true) or string.find(displayLower, query, 1, true) then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

local function startFly()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    if flying then stopFly() end
    flying = true
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bv.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not char or not hrp.Parent then return end
        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local moveDir = Vector3.new()

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        bv.velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
        bg.cframe = camCF
    end)
    logMessage("Fly mode: ENABLED", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120))
end

commandTextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)

    end

    for word in string.gmatch(cleanText, "%S+") do table.insert(args, word) end
    local cmdName = string.lower(table.remove(args, 1) or "")
    
    if Commands[cmdName] then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            Commands[cmdName].Callback(args)
        end)
        if not success then
            logMessage("Execution fault: " .. tostring(err), Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
        end
    else
        logMessage("Unknown directive: '" .. cmdName .. "'. Type 'help'.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
    end
    commandTextBox:CaptureFocus()
end)

            TweenService:Create(mainFrame, twInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(uiStroke, twInfo, {Transparency = 0.1}):Play()

                if not isMainVisible then mainFrame.Visible = false end
            end)
        end
